name: 特征聚类 DRO · 服务反馈
protocol: 最终60期拟合；三轮前向诊断＋训练29—60拟合/1—28回溯反馈校准；测试只吸收已发生需求

reset_holdout.interpretation: disjoint retrospective training episode; not chronological future performance

selection.selection_rule: 28-day held-out training reset service in [.95,.955]; min inventory/demand, then candidate id; three forward folds are prefix diagnostics
selection.final_risk_rule: max full60 and four training-slice risk waterlines; dynamic common scalar lambda chosen causally from remaining service budget and empirical response CDF
selection.response_rule: 128 midpoint quantiles per group; prior/(prior+observed periods), latest window one-step residuals; episode first demand never counted as one-step error
selection.test_initialization: original initial inventory, zero pipeline, Period_1 restart; all28 periods scored
selection.audit_note: Same test file has been evaluated in prior model revisions. Feedback uses only already realized demand, never future demand. Narrow-band guarantee is empirical, not for arbitrary unbounded future demand.
